von dir gehörten Serien und Büchern vors: It suggests series and books based on what you’ve listened to. The more volumes you’ve listened to in a series, the more weight it carries; series you’ve listened to in full and given high ratings count for the most, whilst those you’ve abandoned or given low ratings push similar titles down the list. On top of this, there are sub-genres such as LitRPG or Isekai, what others with similar tastes have listened to, well-known authors and narrators, longer series and the Audible rating.
